channel.title: CRE Deal Makers
channel.description: Company profiles of the firms that shape commercial real estate: their history, what they actually do, the deals that defined them, and who they work with. Narrated by Nora and Theo. New episodes on demand. Hosts are AI-generated voices.
channel.itunes:author: Houz Real Estate

item.title: E02: GFP: The Family Landlord Turning Wall Street Offices Into Homes
item.description: How the Gural family's 1952 Newmark roots became GFP Real Estate, why it split off GFP Development in 2026, and how it turned obsolete Lower Manhattan towers into SoMA (1,320 units), Wrey (788 units) and 40 Exchange Place, plus the Flatiron condos, 100 Gold Street and the Chrysler Building that got away. Hosts are AI-generated voices; researched and scripted with AI from public sources.

item.title: E01: Related Companies: From Affordable Housing to Hudson Yards to AI Data Centers
item.description: How a firm founded in 1972 with a $10,000 loan to finance affordable housing became the developer of Hudson Yards, built a vertically integrated platform with its own fund manager, and closed a $16 billion financing for an AI data center, plus who Related works with and what to know before interviewing there. Hosts are AI-generated voices; researched and scripted with AI from public sources.
